_about: Effect definitions: docs/07-asset-list.md section 9 (an effect is a named set of emitter settings, FX_*.json, plus its textures) and docs/06-art-bible.md section 11.
fx_build.py checks this file and writes one assets/export/fx/FX_<name>.json per effect; those land in ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Fx (docs/09 section 3).
Every emitter is burst-only: Render/Fx clones it onto a pooled Attachment, keeps it disabled (Rate 0) and calls Emit(burst) on the action frame.

Property names are Roblox ParticleEmitter names. Encoding: NumberSequence = [[time, value, envelope], ...]; ColorSequence = [[time, "#RRGGBB"], ...]; NumberRange = [min, max]; Vector2/Vector3 = arrays; enums = the item name ("Grid2x2").
Sizes and speeds are for scale 1.0. Render/Fx multiplies Size, Speed and Acceleration by the scale named in 'scaleWith' (06 section 11.1 rule 8); counts never scale.

'tint' marks a Color that code recolours at spawn: it keeps the keypoint times and white keypoints and replaces every other keypoint with the tint colour ('prey' = the eaten prey's mid colour, 06 section 4.3). The Color here is the fallback, shown with Krill.

Flipbooks (Roblox ParticleEmitter FlipbookLayout/FlipbookMode/FlipbookFramerate). Both sheets are Grid2x2, cells row-major from the top left. T_FX_Bubble_Mask 0-3 = four bubble shapes; T_FX_Star_Mask 0 = slim glint, 1 = fat four-point star, 2 = sparkle, 3 = thin plus, which is also the pop star's animation. FlipbookMode Random (FlipbookFramerate 1, FlipbookStartRandom true, life under 1 s) gives each particle one random cell; Loop at FlipbookFramerate 1 with FlipbookStartRandom false pins cell 0 for a particle that lives under 1 s; OneShot plays the four cells once over the particle's life (06 section 11.3 wants 16 to 24 frames a second).

FX_BiteChomp.what: A bite landed: five bubbles and one lime-white pop star at the mouth (07 section 9.2, 06 section 11.2)
FX_BiteChomp.stillFallback: With flipbooks off the 2x2 sheets show whole: each bubble becomes a cluster of four bubbles and the star a cluster of four star shapes; both still read as a bubbly pop (06 section 11.1 rule 7).
FX_BiteChomp.animation: PopStar plays T_FX_Star_Mask as a 4-frame OneShot flipbook over 0.22 s (18 a second): glint flash, fat star, sparkle burst, plus. 06 section 11.2 asks for a 4x4 flipbook on 512; 07 section 9.2 gives the effect T_FX_Bubble_Mask only and the sprint task two textures, so per 07's precedence over rows and sizes the animation lives in the 256 px 2x2 T_FX_Star_Mask (open conflict, listed for the owner).

FX_BubblePop_T0.what: Plankton eaten: one tiny glint. Nearly free; fires several times a second (07 section 9.2)
FX_BubblePop_T0.stillFallback: With flipbooks off the glint shows as a tiny cluster of four star shapes; at 0.55 studs it still reads as one sparkle.

FX_BubblePop_T1T2.what: Tier 1 and 2 prey eaten: bubble pop and two glints in the prey colour (07 section 9.2)
FX_BubblePop_T1T2.stillFallback: With flipbooks off the shell and bubbles show as four-bubble clusters and the glints as small star clusters; the pop still reads.
